title: RemitFlow — Per-Tenant View
description: Tenant-scoped request rate, latency, and errors from the REAL tenant-labeled series: remitflow_requests_total and remitflow_request_duration_ms, emitted by recordTenantRequest (server/telemetry/tenantContext.ts:91-107) and called in production at server/_core/trpc.ts:100. The `tenant.id` metric attribute becomes the `tenant_id` label in Prometheus. Series without a tenant (public routes) carry no tenant_id and are excluded from the $tenant filter by design.

panels.title: Request Rate by Procedure — tenant $tenant
panels.description: tRPC requests/s for the selected tenant (remitflow_requests_total, tenantContext.ts:33; wired at trpc.ts:100).

panels.title: Latency P99 / P95 — tenant $tenant
panels.description: tRPC request latency for the selected tenant (remitflow_request_duration_ms, tenantContext.ts:38). Name regex covers the UCUM unit-suffix translation variant.

panels.title: Error Rate — tenant $tenant
panels.description: ok=false share of requests for the selected tenant (ok label from tenantContext.ts:97 — there is no status=error label).

panels.title: Money-Path Request Volume — tenant $tenant
panels.description: Request rate on money-path tRPC procedures (transfer/payout/payment-link families) for the selected tenant. HONEST NOTE: true USD payout volumes require remitflow_transfers_amount_usd (otel.ts:212), which is REQUIRES-METRIC — recordTransferMetric has no production call path yet; this panel tracks request counts instead of faking volumes.
